manhart_pwls_tv-claude-agentic: val_n=200, pwls_gamma=0.0, pwls_weight_norm=mean, tv_lambda=0.001, tv_iterations=200, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-2 PWLS-ACTIVATION TEST. iter-1 (gamma=1.0, Manhart) gave hr=0.16648/ssim=0.9612. Mayo lesson: at tv_lambda=0.001 the TV term can dominate the data term ~1000x, making the PWLS ray-weight W=exp(-gamma*p) INERT (Mayo iter-1 g=1.0 vs iter-2 g=0.5 were bit-identical). ONE knob: pwls_gamma 1.0->0.0 (exactly plain TV; W==1 everywhere). HYPOTHESIS: if plain-TV (g=0) hr DIFFERS from iter-1's g=1.0, PWLS ray-weighting is LIVE on breast (128-view sparse data term bites harder than dense Mayo) and gamma is a real lever; if bit-identical, PWLS is inert here and I pivot to TV knobs (tv_lambda/lr/iterations). All else fixed from iter-1. Budget: iter-1 ran 199s<<1200s.

manhart_pwls_tv-claude-agentic: val_n=200, pwls_gamma=1.0, pwls_weight_norm=mean, tv_lambda=0.0001, tv_iterations=200, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-3 PWLS-ACTIVATION (lower lambda). DIAGNOSIS: iter-1 (gamma=1.0) hr=0.16647825 and iter-2 (gamma=0.0 plain TV) hr=0.16647791 differ only at the 8th sig-digit (dHR~3.4e-7) => PWLS ray-weight is INERT at tv_lambda=0.001 (TV term dominates data term, same as Mayo). To let the data term BITE so Manhart's gamma can shape the recon: ONE knob tv_lambda 0.001->1e-4 (10x drop; gamma=1.0 full Manhart kept). HYPOTHESIS: at 10x lower lambda the data-fidelity term is non-negligible, so (a) hr moves materially and (b) PWLS weighting starts to matter; if hr improves this is the productive regime, if it collapses (under-regularized/noisy on 128-view sparse) I back off toward 3e-4. All else fixed from iter-1. Budget: iter-1/2 ran ~200-270s<<1200s.

manhart_pwls_tv-claude-agentic: val_n=200, pwls_gamma=1.0, pwls_weight_norm=mean, tv_lambda=0.001, tv_iterations=400, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-4 CONVERGENCE probe. iter-3 (tv_lambda=1e-4) COLLAPSED hr 0.1665->0.0217 (under-regularized: on 128-view sparse the data term drags in streaks/noise faster than PWLS helps) => lower lambda is the WRONG direction; revert to lambda=1e-3. At lambda=1e-3 plain TV only reaches hr=0.1665/ssim=0.96 in 200 GD iters at lr=0.01 — the data-consistency solve may not be converged. ONE knob: tv_iterations 200->400 (double GD steps, same lambda/lr, gamma=1.0). HYPOTHESIS: more iters enforce data-consistency further so hr climbs past 0.1665; if it saturates the solve is already converged and I pivot to lr/optimizer. Budget: iter-1 200s -> ~400s at 2x iters, <<1200s.

manhart_pwls_tv-claude-agentic: val_n=200, pwls_gamma=1.0, pwls_weight_norm=mean, tv_lambda=0.002, tv_iterations=1000, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-7 REGULARIZATION knob (efficiency pivot). iters 200->400->800->1000 lifted hr 0.1665->0.2178->0.2635->0.2763 monotonically, BUT the data term converged by ~iter 450 (flat 0.740) so all gains are continued TV smoothing, and runtime is now 848s@1000it (wall=1200s) — adding raw iters is nearly exhausted. HYPOTHESIS: stronger TV reaches a more-smoothed optimum in the same 1000 iters so hr rises past 0.2763 at ~same 848s runtime; if it over-smooths (hr drops, fine structure lost) the lambda=1e-3 optimum was near-best and I back toward 1.5e-3. Budget: ~848s, <1200s wall.
